name: Russian Court
summary: A new suspense series that takes place in Israel in the early 90s. In Jerusalem there is a particularly brutal murder of a young woman who immigrated not long ago from the Soviet Union. The investigation is entrusted to the hands of Yehuda, an investigator at the Jerusalem police station in the Russian compound, who discovers a connection to the murder of 12 women in the Soviet Union.

name: Kiss Me with Unspoken Love
summary: Bert meets Ken at a bar, and their one-night stand turns into something much more complicated. When Bert discovers that Ken, who tutors him, is not only his part-time professor but also his aunt's husband, old family wounds surface. Driven by resentment, Bert tries to seduce Ke as a form of revenge. However, Ken's unexpected love for Bert changes everything.

name: Summer indigo
summary: There's one more reason to leave the judo club... Seonwoo wants to leave the judo club, and Taehyung has to stop him A heart-pounding judo club romance

name: Romeo and Romeo and juliet
summary: Ji Su's ex-boyfriend, Hui Jun, and child actor, Ju Yeon, are double-cast as Romeo, entangling Juliet Ji Su in a love triangle.

name: Superestar
summary: At the turn of the century, a comet crossed the Spanish sky, shattering the laws of fame and success and dissolving the line between the popular and the underground. For a few years, the front pages and prime time were taken over by celebrities from another dimension. Creatures who, until then, seemed condemned to ridicule and contempt, who caught our attention without adapting to any kind of normality. A magical story with room for esoteric conspiracies, eternal nights, quantum bricks, multicolored supervillains and an improbability made star: Tamara.

previousepisode.name: La balada de Marimar Cuena Seisdedos

name: Mariliendre
summary: Meri Román was the queen of the gay night in Madrid, but more than 10 years have passed from that. Now, at 35, she is a dethroned diva who lives tormented by her past and bored in her mediocre present. After her father's death, Meri reconnects with her entourage of gay friends, recalling her past and the musical themes that marked that time, while trying to define her chaotic life and identity.

name: Not Suitable for Work
summary: Not Suitable for Work follows five work-obsessed twenty-somethings who strive for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness, in Manhattan.

previousepisode.name: A Birthday Party For the Whole World

name: Endangered Species Aotearoa
summary: Join comedian Pax Assadi and conservationist Nicola Toki on a journey of discovery to learn about the vulnerable wildlife species facing extinction in Aotearoa and the South Pacific. Made with Support from NZ On Air.

name: Double play
summary: As captain, Jeongho is upset when his club gets shut down due to a lack of funding. After negotiating with the school, they are given one last chance. This team can stay active only if they win the next competition. The protagonist must put aside his differences with the star pitcher and work together to save their beloved team.

name: Sonny's Competition
summary: After spending one rainy night together, the souls of two Son Jin Us get swapped?! A newbie outcast and a wild team leader—can they survive the chaos of office life?

name: The Hunt for Peter Tobin
summary: In 1991, two teenagers disappear without a trace in different parts of the UK. Fifteen years later, the murder of a woman in Glasgow reveals a terrible link between all three cases.

name: В темноте
summary: Forty famous people are ready to challenge their rivals and their own phobias. Participants will have to spend forty-eight hours in an unfamiliar building in complete darkness, performing various tasks as a team and in pairs. Only the bravest and most stress-resistant will be able to pass the tests, and outsiders will leave the project. Five heroes take part in each episode.

name: The Essex Millionaire Murders
summary:
When Carol and Stephen Baxter were found dead in their Essex home by their daughter Ellena, the deaths were initially deemed a tragic accident.

Weeks later, toxicology results revealed a chilling truth - both had been poisoned with the powerful opioid Fentanyl. As police launched a double murder investigation, suspicion soon fell on those closest to them. What detectives uncovered was a shocking web of deception - years of manipulation involving catfishing, coercive control, fake medical diagnoses and secret surveillance, all culminating in the couple's murder.

This gripping true crime series unravels a case so twisted that it defies belief - featuring exclusive interviews with the family and Essex police, chilling digital evidence and extraordinary revelations, this stranger-than- fiction investigation exposes how someone within the Baxters' inner circle orchestrated a ruthless campaign of control, fraud, and ultimately murder while watching it all unfold through a nanny cam.

name: Noel Edmonds' Kiwi Adventure
summary:
Noel Edmonds ruled the radio waves and Saturday night TV for over 50 years, but he turned his back on it all in 2018 and travelled 11,500 miles to build a brand-new life in New Zealand with his wife Liz.

Two years ago, they bought land around Ngatimoti - a small rural town - and have been building a hospitality business in the heart of the community including a vineyard, coffee cart, general store, and a restaurant and pub which is about to reopen to the public for its second season.

Noel's latest idea is to build New Zealand's first energy garden, but how will his legacy project and the fledgling business cope when faced with unseasonal weather, bad press, and feelings of being an outsider? As they settle into their new Kiwi life, will Noel's spirit for adventure and his many ideas survive the challenges that New Zealand throws at them?

name: Martin Clunes: Islands of the Atlantic
summary:
Martin Clunes embarks on an epic journey around the islands of the Atlantic. His odyssey takes him to a spectacular array of ocean islands, from the jungles of the African Galapagos, via Madeira, the Azores and the Faroe Islands, and to the frozen heart of Greenland.

While on his travels, Martin discovers the astounding diversity of the Atlantic's island cultures and creatures and little-known stories of resident humans and animals.

name: Joanna Lumley's Danube
summary:
National treasure Joanna Lumley embarks on a rip-roaring adventure across the heart of Europe following the most international river in the world - the Danube. From source to sea, Joanna will track the river from its origins beneath the pines of Germany's Black Forest all the way to the Black Sea.

On the way she'll encounter Bavaria's beer-brewing nuns, Slovakia's stunning snow-capped peaks, Hungary's Great Plain and its distinctive cowboys, the majesty of Vienna and Budapest, the raw beauty of Transylvania, and the unique wilderness that is the Danube delta.

name: Секты
summary: Friends! Every day, thousands of people fall under the influence of cults or similar organizations. How and why does this happen? Can it be prevented? We've worked to unravel this complex topic with experts and created a four-part documentary series exploring why this has occurred in the past and continues to occur today.

name: Paradise Kitchen Bali
summary: Join host, chef and owner of Kynd Community Seminyak Lauren Camilleri as she explores Bali's vibrant culture, rich traditions, and mouthwatering cuisine. From the exotic jackfruit to the versatile coconut, each episode focuses on a specific ingredient, revealing age-old recipes and innovative techniques.

name: El Pelotazo
summary:
Like a pelotazo—the powerful strike of a ball—this show will deliver high-energy sports coverage infused with captivating storytelling and insightful analysis, feature innovative sports highlights, unconventional perspectives, and interactive segments that engage fans in fresh and unexpected ways. Notable segments include: 

MINUTO DE FAMA: Celebrity guests share their passion for sports and discuss their favorite teams and moments. 

!SE BUSCA!: A nostalgic look at legendary sports figures, tracking where they are now and what life looks like after the game. 

MANO A MANO: Exclusive, never-before-heard stories from top athletes worldwide. 

The show will debut with a look and branding designed specifically for El Pelotazo with cutting-edge technology and multiple vibrant positions that mirror the energy of the show. The set combines a bold brand with high-quality production to enhance the viewing experience with innovative graphics and immersive storytelling elements designed specifically for El Pelotazo.

name: Pati Jinich Explores Panamericana
summary: Pati Jinich's life's work has been focused on building bridges between her two beloved countries – her homeland of Mexico and her new home the United States. In this docuseries, the acclaimed chef and James Beard Award winner expands her lifelong mission to uncover cultural connections throughout the Americas and how they enrich each other. Pati embarks on a journey inspired by the Pan-American Highway, a series of roads and a symbol of connection and collaboration extending from Alaska to Argentina.

nextepisode.name: Montana & Wyoming - Small Acts, Wide Ripples

name: Private Operation
summary: A detective series… 8 cases inspired by real-life events in society. Follow an investigative team driven by ideals and the relentless spirit of "hunting dogs" as they unravel schemes and track down criminals with thrilling precision!

name: Takk for alt
summary: Norwegian celebrities get to experience their own funeral before they die. Lying in an open coffin, they listen to family, friends and colleagues eulogizing them.

name: Lost in the Woods
summary: Fifa is 18 years old and dreams of going to Japan, but his application gets rejected. His grandmother offers to help him on the condition of working on the family farm for three months. He accepts, and it's there that he meets the 30 year old park ranger Hem. Against the backdrop of natural beauty, a relationship grows.

name: NightMara
summary: Mara is an 11-year-old foster kid with the power to traverse through people's nightmares in the nightmare world. When people in her town of Brighton City fail to wake up, it seems she's the only one who can save them. But after discovering other NightWalkers are trying to stop her from starting a war of the collected unconscious, Mara has to team up with her own monsters to take on the nightmares.

name: A Wee Drapp an' a Yarn
summary: A Wee Drapp an' a Yarn takes a comprehensive look at Ulster-Scots, examining the history, culture, language, and challenges facing the community today. Drawing on weaver poetry as a historical reference, each episode explores these themes through conversation, offering a unique and engaging way of connecting with the past while envisioning the future of Ulster-Scots in modern society.

name: DOSUKOI Sumo Salon
summary: At DOSUKOI Sumo Salon we break down the sumo world through in-depth analysis and unique stats.

previousepisode.name: DOSUKOI Sumo Salon in Paris – Crossing Borders

name: Carrusel
summary: Abarca la vida cotidiana de un grupo de niños estudiantes de una escuela primaria mexicana ("Escuela Mundial") y las relaciones de estos últimos con su profesora, La maestra Ximena (Gabriela Rivero). En la novela, se tocan varios temas acerca de la vida, además de resaltar valores como el amor, la confianza y la amistad. Uno de los temas expuestos en la novela es de las diferencias entre las clases altas y bajas de la sociedad mexicana - especialmente como se ve en una relación romántica entre Cirilo, un niño negro pobre (interpretado por Pedro Javier Vivero), y una niña rica malcriada, María Joaquina Villaseñor (interpretado por Ludwika Paleta). También se caracteriza por representar cada una de las personalidades infantiles, entre ellas resaltan el bromista, la traviesa, la romántica, el niño bueno, la niña sensible, el estudioso, el desordenado, la presumida, la gringa, el oriental, etc.

name: The Game
summary: A retired detective believes he's finally found the stalker from his unsolved case—but is he right, or losing his grip on what's real?

name: The Culture Is
summary: MSNBC's The Culture Is series aims to generate authentic and thought-provoking conversations across communities of women, including Black, Latina, Asian American Pacific Islander, Indigenous women and beyond.

name: Kowloon Generic Romance
summary: Real estate agents Reiko Kujirai and Hajime Kudo work in the nostalgic Kowloon Walled City. As they spend more time together, Reiko's feelings for Hajime grow. But when she finds a photo of him and his former fiancée, she's shocked to see the woman looks exactly like her. Reiko then realizes a chilling truth: she has no memory of her past.

name: The Shiunji Family Children
summary: An unconventional romantic comedy begins for one young man from the creator of Rent-a-Girlfriend!

name: Your Forma
summary:
In 1992, a pandemic of viral encephalitis shook the world. The medical technology that saved humanity evolved into "Your Forma"—an invasive information device implanted into the brain. In this world where every sight, sound, and even emotion is recorded, investigating major crimes means diving into the collective data, a job reserved for special detectives called "Electronic Investigator."

Echika Hieda, a prodigious "Electronic Investigator" assigned at an astonishingly young age, stands isolated by her exceptional talent. Her newly assigned partner is Harold, a blonde, blue-eyed humanoid "Amicus." Together, this unrivaled duo will expose every hidden secret.

name: Anime.com Hour
summary: Anime has taken the world by storm, capturing the imaginations of fans and rivaling the acclaim of its contemporary American counterparts. Now, this action-packed artform is joining AXS TV, as the Network partners with the L.A.-based anime company Azuki to present the all-new original series Anime.com Hour.

name: Nemesis
summary: Nemesis tells the story of two men on either side of the law. A relentless LAPD cop becomes obsessed with taking down the master thief behind a string of daring heists — and only one can come out on top. It's the tale of what happens when an unstoppable force, expert criminal Coltrane Wilder, meets an immovable object, brilliant police detective Isaiah Stiles.

name: The Anime Business
summary: As anime has grown from modest beginnings into a multi-billion-dollar global industry, the documentary provides insights from many notable people that played important roles in helping to popularize the genre in North America at various stages of its evolution.

previousepisode.name: Jerome Mazandarani and the Rebirth (and re-death) of Manga Video

name: Angry Video Game Nerd
summary: The titular Nerd character is an ill-tempered and foul-mouthed video game fanatic. He derives comic appeal from excessive and inventive use of profanity, frequent displays of explicit gestures, and heavy consumption of beer, particularly Rolling Rock or Yuengling, to "soothe the pain". A particular characteristic is his favorable comparison of extremely repulsive and painful, usually firmly scatological, acts to playing the games he reviews. Varying amounts of physical comedy are mixed into the verbal abuse.

name: The Judd Family: Truth Be Told
summary: The Judd Family: Truth Be Told reveals the complex story of the Judds' including their triumphs and tragedies across several decades. From Naomi's beginnings in Kentucky as a young teen mom, then known as Dianna, struggling to survive with her young daughters, the doc illustrates how the famous country music mother-daughter duo of Naomi and Wynonna Judd came to be and where Ashley stood at the height of Naomi and Wynonna's fame.  Untold truths emerge, illustrating what tied them together, and what also drove them a part. Featuring intimate interviews with many Judd family members, including Wynonna, Ashley, andNaomi's widower Larry Strickland, the doc also speaks to Naomi's closest friends and colleagues including Reba McIntire and Don Potter. Exclusive access to rare family footage and photos, unreleased songs, and voicemails that the Judd women left for one another further illustrate the unique relationship between mothers and daughters, the cyclical nature of generational trauma and the strength of familial bonds.

name: Secrets Declassified with David Duchovny
summary:
Secrets Declassified tells the incredible stories of government secrets that have only recently come to light. This series proves that secrets can be uncovered, and mysteries can still be unraveled." Each episode will find Duchovny focusing on a different topic, speaking with different experts. Subjects include the real-life story behind Argo and the mystery of the Area 51 conspiracy. Mulder would approve.

From black ops and bizarre experiments to deadly cover-ups and nefarious gadgets, David Duchovny pulls the curtain back on all the government secrets in modern history we always suspected, but were never given the answers to. Through the strange and shocking things countries the world over ? and those who work for them ? have done in the name of national interest, we?ll investigate the explosive evidence from newly declassified files that will finally shine a new light on what?s really going on deep in the shadows.

name: Hazardous History with Henry Winkler
summary: The eight-episode fast-paced, nostalgia-fueled series will take viewers on a thrilling ride through America's past.

name: History's Greatest Picks with Mike Wolfe
summary:
Mike Wolfe has spent decades tracking down elusive treasures, hidden gems and bargaining with awesome collectors of the past, but now, it's Mike's turn to share that history by revealing the stories of extraordinary finds by ordinary people.

History's Greatest Picks with Mike Wolfe explores the epic journeys, captivating tales, and astonishing monetary values behind legendary treasures, relics, and artifacts from history. Mike draws on his decades of experience and infectious curiosity to showcase some of history's most unbelievable and high valued items—from iconic vintage cars and motorcycles to pop culture touchstones, rare collectibles, and historic oddities.

With expert insight, compelling historical context, and Mike guiding the audience through these stories, the series reveals surprising new details about how these extraordinary objects have changed hands and risen dramatically in value over time—bringing history to life, one unforgettable pick at a time.

name: History's Deadliest with Ving Rhames
summary: Historoy's Deadliest will reveal the stranger than truth facts behind some of the world's most prolific and powerful killers.

name: Chotto Dake Ai ga Omoi Dark Elf ga Isekai Kara Oikakete Kita
Любовь на линии огня
summary:
The history of mankind is inextricably linked with wars. Behind each of them there are hundreds of thousands of tragedies, millions of ruined lives. But not a single war has managed to kill love. It inspires and gives hope, protects in the fight with death. After all, love is life!

In the documentary series by People's Artist of Russia Boris Shcherbakov "Love on the Line of Fire" there are stories of people who were forever connected by war, and about love that was tempered on the line of fire.

name: L'amore è cieco: Italia
summary: This iconic social experiment turns traditional dating on its head, as Italian singles fall in love and get engaged — all before meeting in person.

name: Vladimir
summary: In Vladimir, as a woman's life unravels, she becomes obsessed with her captivating new colleague. Full of sexy secrets and dark humor, the series is about what happens when a woman goes hell-bent to turn her fantasies into reality.

name: Après la nuit
summary: In the heart of a seaside resort, Stéphanie, Camille, Isabelle and Nafissa, victims of a serial rapist, decide to join forces to break the silence. Attacked at home in the middle of the night, they describe the same modus operandi, the same shock. A matter of life or death, they must speak out, louder and louder, to finally be heard by a desperately deaf community. With the help of Karine, a police officer who makes common cause with them, and Romain, Stéphanie's tormented brother, these heroines fight to rebuild themselves and prevent everything from exploding in their lives...

name: A priori
summary:
After graduating top of the police academy, Iris, 27, joins a police station in the south of France. Upon arriving in this brigade composed of colorful police officers, she receives a more than mixed reception. Her in-depth knowledge of law and her insistence on respecting the rules do not please everyone, especially Victor, 54, her designated partner, a lone cop whose methods are considered outdated.

Despite their age and background differences, when Iris and Victor are assigned a case that is almost closed in advance, by combining their talents, they will discover that it is not a simple car accident but a premeditated crime. If success brings the duo closer, Victor will quickly discover that Iris is not just anyone's daughter... What secret from the past threatens to resurface?

name: Avatar: Seven Havens
summary: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

name: Fourth Wing
summary: Fourth Wing follows twenty-year-old Violet Sorrengail as she leaves the life of a Scribe behind at her mother's demand that she become a dragon rider. At the order of her mother, who is a General in the military of Navarre, Violet enters the brutal ranks of Basgiath War College, which trains up-and-coming riders through the Graduate or Die method.

name: Doppio gioco
summary: Daria, 35, is arrested for gambling and sent to a community to perform socially useful services. Playing poker also means "reading" people: her father, Pietro, taught her this before he died in an explosion when she was only 9 years old. And it is the ability for which Ettore Napoli, of the Secret Services, asks her to collaborate in arresting Gemini, an exponent of international crime passionate about gambling.

name: Ancient Greece by Train with Alice Roberts
summary: Professor Alice Roberts is back on the railways travelling thousands of years into our collective past. This time she's in Greece, to learn more about the Ancient Greeks and how they developed philosophy, art, theatre and ideas around democracy.

name: Положение вещей
summary: During an attack by robbers at the museum, Vadim is injured. This event awakens an unusual gift in him — now he can hear objects and even respond to them. The therapist wants to help Vadim and sends him to the owner of the antique salon, Inga Leonidovna, to protect the rented items. The voices of strange interlocutors do not subside: the superpower helps the main character not only to achieve success at work, but also to find love.

name: Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive?
summary: Bound by friendship, a girl falls for her best friend who reunites with his first crush. Can she convey her newfound feelings?

previousepisode.name: Flowers that Bloom Along the Path of Dreams

name: Premios PLATINO
summary: The Premios PLATINO are organized by EGEDA (Entidad de Gestión de Derechos de los Productores Audiovisuales) and the Federación Iberoamericana de Productores Cinematográficos y Audiovisuales (FIPCA), with the support of the Academies and Film Institutes of Ibero-America. Their objective is to promote and disseminate Ibero-American cinematography and the audiovisual industry, boosting its recognition and expansion worldwide. Over the years, the awards have been hosted in Panama, Spain, Uruguay, and Mexico, bringing together the most prominent figures in the sector.

name: Be Yourself
summary: The old master trains for a century, thinking he is ready to ascend, but a hundred bolts of lightning destroy him. He merges with Zhao Feiyang, the Zhao family's fourth son, who's seen as a loser. Then, three marriage proposals arrive. From that moment, he begins an extraordinary journey.

name: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America
summary: Oklahoma City Bombing: One Day in America features a rare archive and powerful first-hand testimony from witnesses—some sharing their stories for the first time. Former President Bill Clinton and former Oklahoma Gov. Frank Keating reflect on leading a nation in mourning, while survivor Amy Downs relives the harrowing experience of being trapped in the rubble for hours. Edye Raines recalls the frantic search for her two missing children, and first responders, including district fire chief Mike Shannon, recall the desperate fight to save lives. FBI Special Agent in Charge Bob Ricks describes the race against time to find the bomber and bring him to justice. The series provides an intimate yet sweeping portrait of survival, courage and the pursuit of justice in the face of an unthinkable tragedy.

name: Bloodaxe
summary: Bloodaxe is an epic historical drama that chronicles the rise of one of history's most famous Viking warriors, Erik Bloodaxe, and his formidable wife, Gunnhild, Mother of Kings. As they fight for the throne of Norway, the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling and utterly magical new Viking Saga.

name: Heo's Diner
summary: A fantasy romance that takes place 400 years later when Heo Gyoon, a problematic character from the Joseon Dynasty, moves to the modern world to open a restaurant.

name: Child Treatment Certificate
summary: Abdel Sattar, "The Devil's Lawyer," wakes up from a 20-year coma to discover a new world full of challenges and strange comedic situations.

name: El Captain
summary: Captain Hossam Ezz El-Din's life takes a wild turn after a mysterious accident, leading him on an unexpected journey full of surprises and thrilling comedy.

name: Miru: Paths To My Future
summary:
In the distant future, humans create a robot named MIRU capable of traveling through time, visiting various eras, places, and even parallel worlds. Unlike some robots, MIRU isn't equipped with weapons. Instead, it helps people overcome immense obstacles peacefully, encouraging new beginnings without violence.

MIRU continuously evolves by interacting with people, learning and growing to assist those struggling to survive. It listens to their problems and offers support. By helping others, MIRU sets off a "Butterfly Effect," of dramatic change guiding society toward a brighter future.

Why was MIRU created? What is its purpose? Can it save the Earth and humanity from a dystopian future?

name: El Nos
summary: El Nos — after renouncing his bad past, a pickpocket leads a crew into revolution. A must-watch comedy

name: Die Wollnys - eine schrecklich große Familie
summary: The life of the family of thirteen, consisting of eight children still living at home, as well as mum Silvia and dad Dieter. Since 2015, Silvia has stood by her new partner Harald. Since some of the Wollny children have grown up and are having children themselves, the family continues to grow.

name: Visionaries
summary: Keanu Reeves and Gard Hollinger are kindred souls with a bond built on a love of motorcycles and an insatiable curiosity about the world around them. In 2011, they founded ARCH Motorcycle to reimagine what a motorcycle could be. To them, ARCH is a mindset, a lens through which to see the world. This is a journey of curiosity, to understand where human creativity comes from and to shine a light on the visionaries who are pushing the bounds of innovation and changing our world.

previousepisode.name: The Arch Journey, When Inspiration Strikes, Lessons Learned, Curiously Curious

name: L'Europe des merveilles
summary: The Louvre, Versailles, the Acropolis and the Alhambra are among the most visited European monuments. Almost living witnesses to the history of the continent, they are the treasures of our civilisation. Each of the episodes of this documentary series focuses on one of these monuments and offers a fascinating immersion behind the scenes of the construction of these buildings.

name: Nainen joka katosi
summary: A shy lawyer starts a passionated relation with a mysterious woman. When she disapears, he discovers step by step her dark past.

name: Improbably Poppy
summary: An air of transcendence only further stirs the swirl of ambiguity — is Poppy real? Is she a NPC? Do the puppets really die? Those that tune in will be the first to know. Or will they?

name: C.D.I. Código de Investigación
summary: CDI: Código de Investigación is a groundbreaking true crime entertainment program that plunges into the most captivating and shocking crime stories. Each episode features in-depth investigations, expert analysis from criminologists, mental health professionals, police officers, and forensic specialists, powerful testimonials, and cutting-edge technology to bring viewers closer to the truth. CDI examines both past crimes that have shaken communities and follows current cases, providing live updates and exclusive interviews, all delivered with an entertaining approach that combines investigative journalism with compelling narratives.

name: BET Amplified
summary: BET Amplified showcases BET Music's stamp of approval on the next big thing in music. Each month, discover a rising star as we spotlight a fresh, emerging artist through exclusive features and stories.

name: Love You to Death: The Kelly Cochran Story
summary: Michigan police Chief Laura Frizzo and Indiana Detective Jeremy Ogden team up to capture the enigmatic Kelly Cochran for the brutal murders of two men, her own husband, Jason Cochran, and her lover, Chris Regan. As the two investigators struggle to decode the mysterious murderer's mind games, they fall in love and marry, shortly before discovering that a sick & twisted marriage murder pact between Kelly & her husband may have left an endless trail of murder victims across the American mid-west.

name: Moawiya
summary: Within a historical and dramatic context, the series deals with the events of the Great Sedition, which is the period after the martyrdom of the caliph Othman bin Affan, through Ali bin Abi Talib's assumption of power, then the martyrdom of Ali and the assumption of Hassan, then the abdication of Hassan and the assumption of Muawiyah, and the assumption of Yazid, and even the martyrdom of Hussein in Karbala.

name: The Eric Bana Show Live
summary:
The Eric Bana Show Live was an Australian television comedy and talk show hosted by and named after Eric Bana.

The show began as four hour-long specials in 1996 called Eric. In 1997, the show settled into a weekly half-hour slot and was renamed The Eric Bana Show Live. It featured celebrity guests, music, comedy sketches and comedy monologues. Steven Blackburn was the band leader

name: Know Where To Hide
summary: In Know Where To Hide: Who's Not Gone... nine VIPs take on the ultimate challenge in a game that everyone knows from their childhood. What was once an innocent game of hide-and-seek turns into a strategic game of cat and mouse full of tension and tactics.

name: Close to You
summary: Four Crush Stories

previousepisode.name: "Why are you telling me this now?" Sunset Boulevard #2

name: Tahrir
summary: As thousands of angry protesters storm the Israeli embassy in Cairo, five Israeli embassy staff members find themselves trapped inside, as the steel door that separates them from being torn to pieces by violent mobs begins to collapse. No rescue force is able to reach them. The beseiged Israelis realize that these may be the last hours of their lives, and tensions begin to rise among them; Specifically between security agent Tal Shemtov, his childhood friend Roy Barzani, Chief of security and Shemtov's boss, and Barzani's neglected girlfriend Hagar, caught up in the middle with a secret of her own. At a time in history when political and personal interests mix, and values of solidarity and the promise that "no soldier is left behind" are left empty of meaning, unstable friendships and national relations between Egypt and Israel, are pushed to the brink of war.

name: Tybed?
summary: Mysteries for children.

name: Siangdifang
summary: Pirate games for children.

name: Bys a Bawd
summary: Come to the little world of Modryb Baud and the four fingers in the company of Marged Esli.

name: Love Under Construction
summary: Vinod is ready to build his dream house. But is he ready to face the hurdles in his path?

name: Me... In Real Life
summary: Me... In Real Life is a high school drama about a shy teen girl, her rebellious best friend, the chaos of social media, and the pursuit of her first kiss.

name: iHeart Radio Podcast Awards
summary: We love the brilliant storytelling, inspiring us to think differently, making us laugh and helping us learn... Today, Podcasters speak to tens of millions every week. Influencing pop culture AND public opinion. And now iHeartRadio is recognizing the top podcasts in America, based on the podcasts you say are the best. The seventh-annual iHeartPodcast Awards returns, the major Podcast Awards program where your vote will decide who wins. Over 20 categories like Crime, Comedy, Music, Sports, Technology, hundreds of nominees and special guests. The 2025 iHeartPodcast Awards will return live from SXSW in Austin, TX.

name: Na Builders
summary:
There are over 160,000 people employed in the construction industry in Ireland. These people build, renovate and reimagine our countryside and our towns.

Welcome to ‘Na Builders' an original, home-grown series for TG4 that shines the spotlight on construction workers from across the country as they battle the elements - and occasionally each other - to get the job done.

We'll be spending time with builders of all shapes and sizes, in rural and urbans settings; we'll be looking at what they are building and who they are building for and getting a real sense of where we are in building Ireland these days 

From bricklayers to electricians, plumbers to roofers, plasterers to carpenters these hard- working men and women are part of our everyday lives in Ireland. These are their stories.

name: Sonas
summary: Áine Ní Bhreisleáin explores the Wellness Industry in Ireland - body, mind and soul. Áine has been on a journey of change over the past year with a pivot in career as she tries to find more balance in her life. Follow Áine as she tries the latest therapies and treatments and meets with people who have changed their lives in the pursuit of happiness!

name: Total Football
summary:
Football fans, get ready! Total Football, a brand-new weekly show, is taking young fans behind the scenes of the beautiful game. This 10-part series is packed with exclusive access to top players, elite coaches, and the personalities who make football magic happen.

Presented by sports presenter Aisling O'Reilly and rising star Rasdi Nsimba, Total Football isn't just another football show - it's a full-throttle experience. Each week, viewers will see insider insights from the biggest names in the game, while also taking on fun challenges both in-studio and across Ireland!

From national heroes to international sensations, Total Football is calling in the stars. Expect to see Ireland and Premier League aces Caoimhín Kelleher and Evan Ferguson, current Irish stars Amber Barrett and Katie McCabe and former international Julie-Ann Russell - plus a host of surprise guests from the world of football and pop culture. But it's not just the big names making an impact; young reporters from across Ireland will also hit the pitch to interview players, broadcasters, and even sports photographers who bring the game to life.

name: Story of Masters
summary:
Story of Masters will examine the roots of martial arts and its incredible disciplines, exploring how martial arts has made an impact on societies in different cultures around the world.

The series will see Dan travel around the world in search of martial arts stories and legends, reflecting on the huge influence that this incredible combat sport has had on modern civilization. He will travel from Egypt to Rome, from China to Japan and Korea, ending back home in the US. Throughout the series Dan is accompanied by local contributors and together they will look at all the different martial arts forms. Just like the discipline itself, Dan's journey is one of Yin and Yang with physical and spiritual learnings.

name: Домохозяйки против шефов: Битва за вкус
summary: Konstantin Ivlev will challenge Olga Kartunkova to decide who cooks better—men or women. The chef will assemble a team of professional chefs, while Kartunkova's female squad will be represented by the most experienced housewives, whose arsenal includes more than just borscht and vinaigrette.

name: The Morning Show
summary: CBS' first attempt at a morning program debuted on March 15, 1954, with The Morning Show, originally hosted by Walter Cronkite.

name: Good Morning! with Will Rogers Jr.
Glory
summary: After rising star magistrate Lu Jiang Lai is brought down by a past wife-murder case, he's left injured, amnesiac, and on the run, only to be rescued by Rong Shanbao, the Tea King's cunning daughter. Once rivals, she hides his identity and demotes him to a stable boy to exact revenge. As Lu Jianglai plays along to survive, he becomes entangled in the Rong family's high-stakes search for a son-in-law. Amid power plays and hidden agendas, he and Shan Bao engage in a battle of wits that slowly turns into something deeper.

name: Mission Unknown: Atlantik
summary: Ten of Germany's greatest video creators are embarking on an extraordinary adventure: with two sailing boats and two experienced skippers per boat, they are embarking on an exciting race across the Atlantic. They will cover over 2000 nautical miles from Africa to the Caribbean. This epic adventure promises team spirit, challenges and unforgettable moments on the open sea!

name: Epic Drives
summary: Join Motor Trend as we hit 200mph on a German autobahn in a Corvette ZR1, take an Audi R8 past the fjords of Norway, or drive a Lotus Evora 1500 miles through the Rockies. Epic Drives is the ultimate road trip show that puts some of the world's coolest cars on the some of the world's greatest roads -- and brings you along for the ride.

previousepisode.name: Search for a Genesis of New Luxury: Genesis G90 in the Pacific Northwest

name: Freddy and The Eighth
summary:
Get ready for the weird and wonderful world of footy every Wednesday night of the NRL season, when Freddy and The Eighth launches on Channel 9 and 9Now this Wednesday, March 12.

Hosted by Danika Mason, viewers will get a a look through the quirky, weird and wonderful lens of two of the biggest characters in the game - the Eighth rugby league Immortal, Andrew "Joey" Johns, and the most capped NSW State of Origin player in history, Brad "Freddy" Fittler when Freddy and The Eighth is available to watch on Channel 9 at 10.00pm in Sydney and Brisbane, and nationally on 9Now.

name: Secrets at Red Rocks
summary: Jake is drawn into a world of mythical creatures and adventure when he finds a sealskin hidden on the rocky shores of his father's seaside home in Wellington.

previousepisode.name: The Only Way This Can End

name: Disclosure With Dr. Steven Greer
summary: Gaia is proud to present a 10-part series with Dr. Steven Greer, a renowned authority on UFOs and extraterrestrial contact. He is the founder of the CE5 protocol, the Center for the Study of Extraterrestrial Intelligence, and the Disclosure Project.

name: Win, Lose or Draw
summary: The game, based on charades, had contestants and celebrity players sketch clues rather than acting them out.  The game was played by separate teams of men and women, with two celebrities and a contestant on each.

name: Vanessa
summary: Raw, unfiltered, authentic and personal, Vanessa Feltz wants you to tell her what's on your mind. Fiery discussions, a good giggle and plenty of afternoon gossip!

name: The Abduction of Calvin Parker
summary: In 1973, Calvin Parker claimed he was abducted by aliens in Mississippi. This documentary revisits his chilling story with new evidence and expert analysis.

name: Shen diao xia lü
summary: This is the second installment of a trilogy produced by Zhang Jizhong, preceded by The Legend of the Condor Heroes (2003) and followed by The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber (2009). The story concerns the adventures of Yang Guo, an orphaned boy in a mid-13th Century China. From his humble beginnings, the street wise Yang Guo gets passed around from one prestigious master to another but none of them will teach him any martial arts. While escaping from a tortured experience under Quan Zhen Sect's Zhao Zhi Jing, he meets Xiao Long Nu, the girl who will become his martial arts master and eventually the love of his life.

name: Château DIY: Win the Dream
summary: Château DIY: Win the Dream will see aspiring chatelains compete in challenges to prove they have what it takes to win a life-changing prize: an authentic castle in France with multiple bedrooms, living quarters and outbuildings which could be worth up to £250,000 – lower than the average price of a home in the UK. The challengers will compete in a series of heats testing their skills in design, renovation, and business acumen: essential traits they'll need for running their own property. Each challenge will be guided and judged by the familiar faces of Château DIY's main series, who will share their vast and varied expertise of renovating and running these magnificent properties with the competitors. After three weeks of heats, a selection of successful candidates will be put through to the finals week where one lucky pair could win the prize of their dreams.

name: Love After Eternity
summary: The Celestial Lord ruled the Celestial Clan with an iron fist. Ten thousand years ago, he launched the Battle of Immortal-Slaying Platform, forcing Long Xian, the Young Lord of the Dragon Clan, and Ying Luo, the Celestial War God, to perish together. Little did he know that Long Xian was his own grandson, bearing the Celestial Clan's bloodline. Ten thousand years later, Long Xian was reborn in his immortal form. Determined to maximize the success of subduing Long Xian, the Celestial Lord dispatched Ying Luo—the female war god, who had also been reborn—to the Dragon Clan once more. To everyone's surprise, Long Xian abandoned direct confrontation this time. Instead, he offered her the Position of Dragon Clan Protector, vowing to exchange his sincere heart for her true feelings and risking everything to turn her to his side. Amidst their clash of schemes, a bond of mutual sympathy grew between them. Unwilling to tolerate betrayal from his subordinate, the Celestial Lord sealed Ying Luo's divine powers. Their karmic bond spanning multiple lifetimes finally led them to repeat their fate at Immortal-Slaying Platform. Long Xian sacrificed himself to the sword and vanished from the mortal realm. Ying Luo waited faithfully for ten thousand years, clinging to the hope of reuniting with her beloved through a rift in time and space...

name: Hollyoaks: Let Loose
summary: The prequel to Hollyoaks in the City, Hollyoaks Let Loose followed iconic Hollyoaks characters, Ben Davies and Lisa Hunter as they leave their hometown of Hollyoaks in Chester and head for a new life abroad. However, Lisa's behaviour puts her and Ben's relationship at risk. She wonders whether she was right to leave Hollyoaks when confronted with the responsibility of looking after Ben's child. The series also touched on Lisa's battle with self-harm.

name: Sioncyn Sboncyn
summary: For the youngest viewers.

name: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
summary: Dr. Sandra Lee, also known as Dr. Pimple Popper, is the most famous dermatological surgeon in the world and an internationally beloved personality. She has dedicated her life to sharing her incredible skills with her huge audience, as she helps hundreds of suffering patients who are unable or unwilling to find treatment for their painful, oozing cysts, fatty tumors, and infinitely complex, life-affecting dermatological issues. Now, Dr. Lee is ready to take her practice to the next level. The doctor has made modern additions to her main office which include an entire new wing of patient rooms, and many new staff and doctors. For the first time, Dr. Lee will also be providing intimate self-shot footage of her life outside the office.

name: The Official Big Bang Theory Podcast
summary: Fans will get to hear backstage secrets and previously unheard stories as well as learn about the creative process and decision-making that brought each episode to life through conversations with guests like director James Burrows and cast members Kunal Nayyar, Kevin Sussman, and John Ross Bowie. The first podcast episode will offer a special look into the unaired pilot with co-creator Chuck Lorre and former Warner Bros. Television Group Chairman Peter Roth. Additional guests include Sara Gilbert, Christine Baranski, Vernee Watson, Sara Rue, and many more.

name: Wild Iberia
summary: The landscape of the Iberian Peninsula ranges from jungle-like forests to the driest deserts. In the north loom the snow-capped mountains of the Pyrenees and in the south flow the prairies. Filmed with super high-speed cameras and time-lapse photography, from the Iberian lynx to the Royal eagle; the ant lion to the dragonfly – this is Spain, wild and alive.

name: Asteroids: A New Horizon
summary: Witness how asteroids, those rocky, mysterious celestial bodies, could become a new frontier for humanity in the near future. We are at the forefront of a modern-day gold rush, and asteroids could hold the key for private companies to launch into deep space. Dive into the science and engineering behind the companies leading that race, which potentially hold the future of humanity in their hands.

name: Vale Tudo
summary: Raquel, a hard-working woman who works as a tour guide in Foz do Iguaçu, Paraná. She believes that it is possible to succeed in life with dignity. On the other hand, her daughter, Maria de Fátima, a young woman uninterested in the routine of the quiet city of Paraná, dreams of becoming a digital influencer and getting rich at any cost.

name: Wylde Pak
summary: Wylde Pak follows half-siblings Jack and Lily as they are pushed outside their comfort zones and learn to coexist while navigating new family dynamics, friends, and endless hijinks, all while helping run the family's pet grooming and boarding business. With guidance from their parents and grandmother, the two will learn about each other's previously separate lives, blended identity, vibrant culture, and the importance of family.

name: Мастер игры
summary: According to the rules of the show, 22 participants gather together in a luxurious villa, where they will have to undergo tests and conduct a hidden struggle. Three players from the very beginning become "dark" - their task is to hide their role, eliminate rivals and manipulate the rest. The rest are "light", their goal is to identify traitors and save the team. However, during the game, anyone can join the "dark".

name: Большой куш. Бангкок
summary: A new reality show in which high stakes, risky moves and brilliant combinations are on the verge of fantasy. "A big jackpot. Bangkok is a game worthy of Guy Ritchie's script. 12 star pairs, one suitcase with 10 million rubles, ten empty ones and one with a black flight pass. Here, every move decides everything. Bluffing, risky exchanges and big bets — participants can not only hit the jackpot, but also radically change their fate. And the presenters Pavel Volya and Laysan Utyasheva will not give them a minute's peace and will add spice to the game.

name: Touch of the Frozen Heart
summary: The fallen princess, Nangong Ying, personally stabbed Crown Prince Su Wuying, who loved her deeply, to avenge her kingdom's destruction. Su Wuying believed his heart had died the moment Nangong Ying poisoned him. Yet five years later, when he saw her living in harmony with the young general Pei Xian, that supposedly dead heart still ached and burned with jealousy, driving him to madness.

name: Silent Tides
summary: It tells the legendary story set during Macau's "Silent tide" period, when Hong Kong banking magnate Ho Yin joined forces with patriotic youth Qiao Yinwan, underground Communist agents Ke Lin and his brother Ke Zhengping, and patriotic businessman Ma Man Kei. Together, they engaged in fierce battles of wits and courage against Japan's "Ze Agency" and its collaborators in areas such as finance, intelligence, and material transport. For the first time, the camera turns its focus to Macau during World War II, an "isolated island" that was never occupied by Japan, yet still bravely resisted and shared in the nation's suffering.

name: My Destined Consort
summary: Shen Jiangli, the virtuous and kind lineal daughter of the Shen family, is forced into a relationship on her wedding night with Lu Jingming, the second young master of the Lu family, and later framed and locked away in the ancestral hall. After a near-death experience during childbirth, she survives, but her son, Yan, is born with a serious illness, and the only cure lies in the hands of the Lu family. For the sake of her son, Shen Jiangli returns to the Lu Mansion. There, she fights back against those who once humiliated her, uncovers the truth behind the conspiracy back then, and clears the misunderstandings between her and Lu Jingming. With Yan playing the perfect little matchmaker, the estranged couple slowly find their way back to each other...

name: The Dinner Table Detective
summary: The story takes place in Kunitachi in Tokyo, where Reiko Hōshō, daughter of the owner of the world-famous Hōshō Group, has become a rookie detective. Her boss is Inspector Kazamatsuri, the son of the owner of Kazamatsuri Motors. The two work to solve difficult cases. When tackling her cases, Reiko always consults her butler and driver Kageyama, who spouts harsh language insulting Reiko but always brilliantly manages to solve the case.

previousepisode.name: What is it that you have lost?

name: Strim, Stram, Strellach
summary: Children's magazine.

name: Adultery
summary:
Adultery introduces us to Tom's 15-year-old daughter Jess who has found love with schoolmate Ollie, and they can't take their hands off one another, as love's young dream becomes all consuming. When Tom meets Ollie's Mum Beth in the most unexpected of circumstances, the two families' lives are potentially turned upside down forever. Will Tom and Beth be able to control their desires unlike their lovestruck teenagers?

Adultery raises questions about class, grief and the effects of social media, as it takes the viewer on a rollercoaster story of passion, parenthood and peril, as our protagonists Tom and Beth embark upon a passionate and intense love affair that threatens to uproot their whole lives.

name: Fo a Fe
summary: Classic comedy with Ryan Davies and Guto Roberts.

name: Number One on the Call Sheet
summary: Some of Hollywood's biggest stars reveal their journeys to game-changing leading roles. In candid interviews, they shine a light on the highs and lows of their craft, breakthrough moments, blueprints for success, and the next generation's huge potential.

name: Bienvenidos a la familia
summary: A struggling single mom rallies her quirky family to outsmart a mafia boss after her estranged, wealthy father dies, leaving them with massive debt.

name: Telesylw
summary: News for children.

name: Coven Academy
summary: In the haunted heart of New Orleans, Coven Academy follows three teenage witches and their dangerously charming warlock peers at an elite magic boarding school where power is currency, secrets are lethal and attraction is a liability. Caught between ancient supernatural wars and forbidden love interests, the coven must decide how far they're willing to go to protect their city—and themselves.

name: Street Art Challenge
summary: Street Art Challenge brings artists from different cities together for unique assignments: to blend their styles and perspectives into a new work of street art.

name: The Duel of Hearts
summary: Lyu Shao and Li Dun were once lovers, but fate had other plans—one became a consort, and the other a prince. Unable to attain Lyu Shao's love, Li Dun grew resentful, especially since her brother, Lyu Xun, was his romantic rival. After ascending the throne, his love for Lyu Shao twisted into cruelty. Determined to escape Li Dun's grasp, Lyu Shao devised a plan to flee. However, on her way, she encountered Consort Wenzhao. During their confrontation, a bolt of lightning struck them, and when they awoke, they had swapped bodies. As Li Dun began to notice unusual changes in Wenzhao's behavior, the real Wenzhao, now inhabiting Lyu Shao's body, realized she had unexpectedly risen to the position of Empress Dowager. Ambitious and power-hungry, she used Lyu Xun's love for his sister and her newfound authority to repeatedly try to eliminate Lyu Shao. Yet each time, Lyu Shao fought back. When Li Dun finally uncovered the truth about the body swap, Lyu Shao pleaded for her freedom. But unwilling to let her go, Li Dun imprisoned her once more—committing an irreversible mistake in the process.

name: Афоня
summary:
Afonya is a brownie with experience, accustomed to life in the old Khrushchev, where everyone knows each other. But now he's being moved to a modern apartment complex where people don't even greet their neighbors. Together with his longtime friend Semenych, a former pediatrician, he decides to restore order – grandpa gets a job as a concierge, and Afonya takes the situation into her (magical) hands.
But will they be able to bring comfort and harmony to a house where some make noise at night, others hide behind gadgets, and others do not believe in brownies at all? There is a lot of humor, magic and unpredictable adventures in the new comedy series!

name: Death At The White Hart
summary: Death At The White Hart is set in the Dorset village of Fleetcombe, where the village pub's landlord is found murdered. Detective Nicola Bridge must unpick a web of lies and rivalries to unmask the killer.

name: Beauty Newbie
summary: Katagiri Mirei has been constantly bullied due to her appearance. She decides to take the opportunity to undergo plastic surgery and obtain a beautiful face before entering college. During the school orientation, Mirei receives multiple compliments on her appearance from her classmates, while she is confused, she is secretly elated. However, her joy is short-lived when an incident leads to everyone discovering that she has done plastic surgery. At the same time, Mirei reunites with Sakaguchi Kei, a handsome classmate from her middle school.

name: Zhidao Woshi Zongcai Ni Zengmo Houhuile

previousepisode.name: Shawarma do Tio Ali - Foz do Iguaçu/PR

name: The Visioneers with Zay Harding
summary: In The Visioneers with Zay Harding The Visioneers will take viewers around the world as it showcases the scientists, engineers, and everyday people who are creating environmental solutions.

name: Hangi Pit Masters
summary: Rewi Spraggon enlists six of the best chefs in Aotearoa and gets them to add their expertise, tastes and techniques to a traditional Māori hāngī under the gaze of thousands at one of the biggest food shows in Aotearoa, Taste of Auckland.

name: Club Friday Theory of Love: The 21-Day
summary:
Psychological studies have found that repeating an action for twenty-one consecutive days can help change a person's behaviour, such as waking up early or exercising. The idea, extended to matters of love, evolves into the 21-Day Theory: the belief that if you pursue someone for twenty-one consecutive days, you'll win their heart. But what happens when a woman uses the 21-Day Theory in an attempt to turn a gay man straight? 
A woman has had a crush on a wealthy and seemingly perfect man who's remained single for a long time. Rumors swirl about his sexual orientation, but she refuses to believe them. He never confirms or denies the speculation that he's gay. Determined to uncover the truth for herself, she employs the theory to pursue him.

name: Llon a Llwyd
summary: Puppet series introduced by OIwen Rees

name: Bam-bw!
summary: Wildlife quiz

name: Princession Orchestra
summary:
Alicepia, a land of wonder that has existed somewhere in the world since ancient times, was once home to loving inhabitants known as the Alicepians. Their peaceful lives were disrupted when a mysterious monster, Jamaock, began to appear, threatening the sparkling brilliance of their homeland. If nothing is done, Alyspia will lose its radiance forever.

This is the story of the "Princesses," whose unwavering songs of courage and hope shine even in the darkest times. A pop-song fantasia filled with energy and bravery -- Princession Orchestra!

name: Blazing Elegance
summary: Middle school teacher Zhao Xingrou and the warlord marshal Yi Qiuting fall in love, but their love is thwarted by differences in family backgrounds. Yi Qiuting's tough tactics even leads to misaligned affection in their relationship. When she thinks she has lost her child, Zhao Xingrou fakes her death and leaves. Many years later, she makes a comeback and proves with her actions that women can live a glorious life independently.

name: Stephanie's Places
summary: Stephanie's Places follows WWE icon Stephanie McMahon as she explores the pockets of America that helped shape the journeys of some of the most famous names in WWE history.

name: The Secret Contract of the Witch
summary: Witch Matriarch Xia Mo is bound by a deadly curse after losing her necklace. Desperate to reclaim it, she strikes a dangerous bargain with Mu Hanyu, a vengeful physics professor and vows to fulfill his wish. By frequent contact, they gradually fall in love. However, fate pits them against each other...

name: Dreamers
summary: Dreamers follows an eclectic group of dance students as they navigate the intense highs and lows of coming of age in today's complex world – captured through stories which are as joyful and funny as they are raw and truthful, brought viscerally to life via irresistible dance choreography.

name: Secrets of the Penguins
summary: On the 20th anniversary of National Geographic's Academy Award®-winning "March of the Penguins," SECRETS OF THE PENGUINS changes everything we ever believed to be true. From the emperor penguins' revelatory bonds of friendship to the gritty resolve of gentoos and rockhoppers and the astonishing ingenuity of the migrant penguins that reached deserts and far beyond, their incredible traditions and societies echo ours in ways we never dreamt possible — until now. For over two years, BAFTA and Emmy® Award-winning wildlife cinematographer Bertie Gregory has collaborated with world-leading scientists, using cutting-edge camera technology and unique access to capture three world-first episodes that resonate with our lives like never before.

name: Love Overboard
summary: Get ready to hit the high seas with Love Overboard! Step aboard the ultimate luxury yacht, where sexy singles are ready to mix and mingle … and find love. But there's a twist … gaining access to the yacht's extravagant amenities won't be so simple. As the journey unfolds, romance ignites; alliances form; and hearts are shattered. In the end, only one couple will reign supreme. Who will rise to the top, and who will be left stranded?

name: The Gen Zone
summary: Host, Jhone Lucas, takes The Gen Zone team around the country documenting the race to the White House providing a Gen Z perspective on the Presidential campaigns of Kamala Harris/Tim Walz and Donald Trump/JD Vance.

name: Se potessi dirti Addio
summary: Marcello, a mysterious patient with no memory, in hospital for over a year. Elena, a passionate neuropsychiatrist searching for the person responsible for her husband's death. When these two lives intersect, it doesn't happen by chance. Maybe these two lives have something that connects them.

name: Marry Me Again
summary: To save her late fiance Tang Jingxing's struggling Chinese jewelry brand, Mi Chuxia teams up with celebrity influencer Lu Yi. As they work together to revive the company, sparks of romance begin to fly. But when Chuxia discovers Lu Yi's true identity as Tang Jingxing himself, she must confront the shocking truth behind his presumed death in a car crash three years earlier.

name: The Future of Nature
summary: The Future of Nature takes a rare look at the vital role of carbon in our planet, and the power of nature in helping to restore and stabilize our ecosystems.

name: Urvi Went To An All Girls School
summary:
Urvi Went To An All Girls School is a coming-of-age comedy about one teen girl's survival, with disastrous and hilarious consequences. Urvi is an awkward, unpopular 16-year-old girl entering Year 11, at the painfully academic, selective public school Grogan Girls High. She desperately wants to become a famous actress, and dreams of being noticed by Hot Ryan, the hottest Year 12 at Grogan Boys.

Urvi's school year looks doomed. Her little sister Maya has skipped a grade and joined forces with Urvi's school bullies, her parents want her to become a doctor and the only boy she knows is her dad. That is until a Grogan Girls alumni turned soap actress named Sophie turns up out of the blue to direct the Grogan Girls and Boys combined school musical. Urvi finally sees a path to stardom - and sacrifices her other subjects (and her sanity) to pursue her dream.

name: Westerners
summary:
Westerners follows three young diaspora adults navigating the chaos of life in Western Sydney, where even the simplest tasks spiral into the surreal.

Jackie, a struggling artist, makes a deal with the Devil to cure her creative block. Taz must choose between living with share house mould or even worse: moving back in with her parents. Dulla  can't walk down the street without being chased by a horde of women who all want to play matchmaker. Between existential crises and absurd misadventures, they're just trying to live their version of an ordinary life.

name: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: Domestic Incident
summary: It's often said that the people who can inflict the most harm upon you are the ones closest to you. This is the story of a single mother whose world revolves around her son, her closest companion. As the weight of responsibilities become overwhelming, she goes looking for love, hoping to create a fresh start for her family and mend her weary heart. The new man in her life seamlessly becomes a part of the family, effortlessly meeting all the criteria she had set for him. "Love her and, more importantly, love her son" was the foremost requirement, and he fulfilled it admirably. Despite their deep bond, she had always believed there had been a gap she couldn't bridge. Now, her son has a role model in his life. They spend time together, engaging in typical father-son activities like watching and playing football and their blooming relationship fills her with warmth. However, she remains unaware of the true nature of the bond between her son and his stepfather. When the truth comes to light, she'll face a heart-wrenching decision.

name: Now for Nookie
summary: Roger De Courcey and Nookie the Bear star in this children's comedy series.

previousepisode.name: Pour que d'autres ne meurent pas

name: Thames Water: Inside the Crisis
summary: Trouble at the UK's biggest water company. Behind the headlines to witness the business's fight for survival - and the teams on the front line trying to keep things flowing.

name: Rouge forêt
summary: Stranded after their bus breaks down, students must survive in the woods as days pass without rescue. As mysterious events occur, they race to uncover the truth behind their driver's disappearance.

name: The Death Coast
summary: The Death Coast is an area of rough sea in the North Atlantic that's claimed more than six thousand vessels across centuries. Many sailors braved these waters – some for trade, some for war, and some for plunder. Gold and priceless objects from their wrecked ships now lie scattered across the ocean floor but salvaging has been banned here for the last decade. Now, after a long battle, shipwreck hunter Jeff Mackinnon has won exclusive rights to dive. He and his team have just 12 weeks to search the wrecks before the turbulent waters of the Death Coast make diving impossible.

name: Дуплет
summary:
Anya and Masha Gorbachev are sisters by their father, whom they have never seen. Fate brings them together in the same investigative department, where Anya serves as an investigator and Masha as an operative. 

They have different personalities and different approaches to work. But eternal contradictions and irreconcilable differences will be the key to the success of this couple, who will have to solve more than one crime together.

name: Creepy Bits
summary: Creepy Bits is a 10-episode chilling horror collection that delves deeper into the unknown, drawing inspiration from contemporary issues and venturing into uncharted territories of fear. Each episode is helmed by a diverse range of innovative filmmakers, including Ashlea Wessel, Adrian Bobb, Kelly Paoli, Sid Zanforlin, and  creator David J. Fernandes. The series explores themes of human vs. nature, the invasion and destruction of the natural world, and isolation within a vast, eerie landscape that fights back. From the depths of the forest to the darkness of the lake, to quaint small towns, each episode promises to unsettle and disturb.

name: Rob Brydon's Honky Tonk Road Trip
summary:
Country music is exploding in popularity in Britain and music fan Rob Brydon, who once topped the charts with his own take on a country classic (Barry) Islands in the Stream, with Gavin and Stacey co-star Ruth Jones, is hitting the road on a round trip of America's southern states in search of the people, places and culture where country music roots run deep. He'll be meeting the stars, hanging out with locals and immersing himself in the way of life.

It's an entertaining, fascinating and laughter filled exploration of country music, past and present, during which Rob discovers its origins, the secrets to its longevity and what led to its recent global explosion all set against the epic backdrop of the American south.

name: The Forsytes
summary: The Forsytes chronicles the lives, loves, trials and triumphs of a wealthy late Victorian stockbroking family, whose generations are torn between the tradition and self-sacrifice versus personal happiness and the pursuit of love. Family stability is threatened by two chance encounters for rival cousins, Jolyon and Soames, throwing their previously steady lives into disarray.

name: Seven Sisters
summary: In Seven Sisters, a large, tightknit family begins to unravel when a sister starts communicating with a voice no one else can hear — forcing each of them to confront long-buried secrets.

name: Prison Break: Black Creek
summary: In the new Prison Break: Black Creek, a soldier-turned-corrections officer takes a job at one of the deadliest prisons in America to prove just how far she'll go for someone she loves.

name: Bummi
summary: When a little bear named Bummi discovers the world with his friends, adventure and lots of fun are guaranteed.

name: Phoenix Alliance
summary: In their past lives, the Empress and the Imperial Consort locked in fierce rivalry. Their untimely deaths then revealed the bitter truth: they were nothing but pawns, discarded by the Emperor. Reborn, the Empress returns to the very day the Emperor falsely accused the Consort and caused the death of her unborn royal child. This time, she does everything she can to protect her former enemy. However, she finds out that the Consort has been reborn too! With their identities confirmed, the two sworn enemies become allies, determined to drag the unfaithful Emperor down from his throne.

name: Wu You Wu Lv Cheng Zhang Ji
Bound at First Sight
summary: Pei Yan Yan and Gao Song fell in love in high school but broke up before they graduated college. As time passes, the two are brought back together through their careers 7 years later. Gao Song is now a university teacher and cybersecurity expert, while Yan Yan is a media reporter. Gao Song begins to realize he is still in love with Yan Yan and decides to break up with his girlfriend in an attempt to pursue Yan Yan again. Love and hate are two sides of the same coin. They both harbor resentment and love. Yan Yan turns a blind eye until Gao Song encounters a life-staking crisis. Only then does Yan Yan begin to admit her true emotions.

name: #Somebody's Son
summary: #Somebody's Son, a one-of-a-kind dating journey in the world of Black love, romance and family. The series is derived from the popular hashtag (#SomebodysSon) that celebrates the search for Black love, bringing the online sensation to life on screen. It follows three charming, single and successful men as they embark on a high stakes search for true love, looking for a lasting partner amongst a group of exceptional single women. But there's someone extra along for the ride -- each of their mothers will be joining them on this adventure, offering guidance, support and a little drama as they help (or attempt to help) their sons find the one. Through competitive challenges, bonding activities and heartfelt moments, the moms play a pivotal and sometimes divisive role in determining if mother truly knows best when it comes to matters of the heart.

name: The Not Very Grand Tour
summary: Richard Hammond and James May look back at nostalgic clips of The Grand Tour.

name: The Battle of the Atlantic
summary: Second World War series exploring the desperate struggle for survival on a hostile ocean.

name: Food for the Soul
summary: A group of college girls will build new friendships around their love of food!

name: Finisterra
summary: Western Algarve, 1943. In the midst of World War II, Portugal declares neutrality, but in the isolated village of Aljezur, the reality is different. German air raids on Allied ships off the coast spread fear among the population, still marked by a history of witchcraft. Celeste, a young orphan from a heretical family, is accused of being the heir to this evil that caused so many past tragedies. Betrayed and expelled from the village, she sets out in search of the truth about her parents' death, her identity and revenge against those who condemned her. Meanwhile, the growing Nazi presence in the region hides dark secrets. A story of mystery, superstition and resistance to oppression, which questions the very malleable nature of truth.

name: Harris and Company
summary: A working-class African-American father of five relocates his family from Detroit to Los Angeles after the death of his wife.

name: The Traitors Italia
summary: A group of celebrities roam a spectacular mansion challenging each other in a psychological game that involves constant teamwork to complete missions and accumulate a cash prize. But hidden among the contestants are traitors who will try to deceive and manipulate the rest of the group to grab the ultimate prize for themselves alone, while the others, unaware of who the traitors are, work as a team with the aim of eliminating them from the game. The stakes will be high and will test everyone's ability to juggle a dense web of alliances and betrayals. If at least one traitor makes it to the end of the game he will keep the entire prize money for himself, but if all the traitors are unmasked, the other participants still in the game can divide the prize equally.

name: Endurance: 24 hours at Spa
summary: Every summer, the Total 24 Hours of Spa GT3 race is held in Belgium. This series goes behind the scenes with the drivers and pit crews fighting for victory.

name: Culiacanazo Herederos del Narco
summary: A gripping docuseries chronicling the attempted arrest of notorious drug lord Ovidio Guzmán, son of "El Chapo," and the tragic violence that ensued.

name: Go!
summary: A young sprinter, Siya, is given a life-changing scholarship to a prestigious school in Johannesburg. While racing toward his dreams of athletic success, he must also outrun the trauma and painful memories that haunt him, learning that the real race is not only on the track but also within himself.

name: Hunting Love
summary: To avenge her mother's death, Wan Lin goes undercover for three years, posing as the fiancée of Fu Yan, heir to the underworld empire in Mai City. But on their wedding day, during a raid led by her own agency, Wan Lin shoots Fu Yan. When they meet again, enemies become allies. As Wan Lin begins to see the sincerity in Fu Yan's heart. Together, they dismantle the criminal forces from within. Vengeance eventually gives way to love, and the two step into a new life, hand in hand.

name: Heart Pairing
summary: They're young and serious about love — meet the singles looking to marry. With the MCs' help, couples hope to find a lifelong partnership.

name: Something Is Not Right
summary: Where will my suppressed feelings finally burst out go? A romance of unrequited love with different dreams that will lead nowhere!

name: La cacería
summary: La cacería is inspired by shocking police cases that have shaken public opinion in Chile, with the aim of reflecting on these, looking backwards from today. On each season, the former detective César Rojas (Francisco Melo) deals with stucked unresolved cases due to authorities' negligence.

name: Business as Unusual
summary: Kim Minjun is your average 30-year-old office worker. Now that he's older, Minjun is feeling the pressure to accomplish more in life, and he can't shake the feeling that something is missing amidst the monotonous routine of his 9-to-5 job. Out of nowhere, his ex-boyfriend Jinhwan shows up as a new co-worker, looking as handsome and charismatic as ever while Minjun feels like he hasn't progressed at all since their breakup 10 years ago. Determined not to let an ex from a decade ago mess with his work life, Minjun just wants to carry on with business as usual. But it seems that Jinhwan has other plans in mind…

name: Ambulance
summary: Each year in Israel, two million people dial 101 to receive an emergency medical service. More than 5000 calls a day are received at the MDA call centers throughout the country. The series "Ambulance" follows the medical teams through their critical moments, their breaking points and their moments of happiness.

name: ZatsuTabi -That's Journey-
summary: An aspiring manga artist travels around Japan to find unexpected treasures!

name: From a Cult Leader to a Beloved Wife
Vizinhos para Sempre
summary: Vizinhos para Sempre portrays the lives of the residents of Terraços do Glamour, a recent and poorly built condominium. The series explores tense and fun relationships, between connections, such as absurd disputes, impossible loves and unexpected alliances; and has as its backdrop the housing crisis and typical neighborhood conflicts. All this with an irreverent and current humor.

previousepisode.name: Solteiros, Disfunções Sexuais e um Afogado

name: Dear My Secretary
summary: Thee Chonlathorn, a confident and accomplished CEO, is thrown off balance when his loyal secretary of nine years, Preem Primala, unexpectedly resigns. As he seeks answers, their journey uncovers hidden emotions and truths that could change their lives forever.

name: Otherwords
summary: Otherwords digs deep into this quintessential human trait of language and finds the fascinating, thought-provoking, and funny stories behind the words and sounds we take for granted. Incorporating the fields of biology, history, cultural studies, literature and more, linguistics has something for everyone and offers a unique perspective on what it means to be human

previousepisode.name: How Fast Can a Word Change Its Meaning?

name: Eons
summary: Join hosts Michelle Barboza-Ramirez, Kallie Moore, and Blake de Pastino as they take you on a journey through the history of life on Earth. From the dawn of life in the Archaean Eon through the Mesozoic Era — the so-called "Age of Dinosaurs" -- right up to the end of the most recent Ice Age.

previousepisode.name: Why Were Sails So Popular 300 Million Years Ago

name: Be Smart
summary: Join Joe Hanson as he explores curiosity and illuminates the science behind… well, everything.

previousepisode.name: The Very Weird Reason Hot Water Freezes Faster

name: In the Margins
summary: In the Margins covers the history they didn't teach in school, exploring obscure, yet captivating tales that offer unique insights into their time and place.

previousepisode.name: The Hidden Black Society They Don't Teach You About

name: Pepee
summary: Pepee is a 5 year old boy living with his loving family and friends in endless green fields. During his daily little adventures, Pepee learns shapes, colours, numbers... With his cute little sister Bebee, cousin Shila, grandparents, giraffe and monkey friends, he discovers the emotions and learns how to deal with them.

name: Akedo: Ultimate Arcade Warriors
summary: Jet, Bria and Cub are determined to become legends in the Akedo Championships. They do their best to level up their skills to reach their goal.
